text: Alms, for the love of God. Alms for the poor lepers of Saint Lawrence's. I'll come no nearer.
speaker: p278

text: God reward you, master. We'll pray for you at Saint Lawrence's.
speaker: p278

text: God keep you, all the same.
speaker: p278

text: No nearer, friend. You know you can't come into the town. Back to Saint Lawrence's with you, and God help you.
speaker: p273

text: Let me in, master, I beg you. There's work at the quay, unloading the ships. I'm strong. I can work.
speaker: p232

text: Strong enough to work, and begging at my gate? How do I know you won't be cutting purses in the market by noon?
speaker: p273

text: If the merchant will answer for you, then in you go. And mind you're off the streets by curfew.
speaker: p273

text: Go on, then. But I'll know your face, and if there's trouble, I'll know where to look.
speaker: p273

text: Not today. Try Saint Bartholomew's, over the Frome. They feed the poor there.
speaker: p273

text: God bless you, master. You won't regret it.
speaker: p232
